"""Settings for the static site server, read from an INI file."""

import configparser


def load_settings(path):
    parser = configparser.ConfigParser()
    parser.read(path, encoding="utf-8")
    settings = {}

    if parser.has_option("server", "host"):
        settings["host"] = parser.get("server", "host").strip()
    else:
        settings["host"] = "127.0.0.1"

    if parser.has_option("server", "root"):
        settings["root"] = parser.get("server", "root").strip()
    else:
        settings["root"] = "/srv/www"

    if parser.has_option("logging", "file"):
        settings["log_file"] = parser.get("logging", "file").strip()
    else:
        settings["log_file"] = "server.log"

    if parser.has_option("server", "port"):
        settings["port"] = parser.getint("server", "port")
    else:
        settings["port"] = 8000

    settings["debug"] = parser.getboolean("server", "debug", fallback=False)
    return settings
